status: measured and recorded. No published number changes; q_sim_upper is untouched and nothing here enters it. Supplies the parameterised transverse departure R1B and R1C recorded the strategy portfolio as lacking, as a diagnostic and not as a cost.
subject: src/aionq/fishnet.py -- a QFFO spectral multiplier applied to a fermionic network, at two different levels
the_proposal_being_tested: that quantum-fractal-fractional operators are tooling for exciting the hypercomplex network rather than a source of fractal sets. R1E had placed a QFFO as a coefficient multiplier on the disk and concluded it could supply a spectral band weight and no set carrying a dimension. Placed on the Majorana network instead, it has two applications that sound alike and behave oppositely.

measurement.setting: n = 3 qubits, 6 Majorana modes, Gaussian unitary exp(iH) with H = (i/4) sum A_jk c_j c_k for random real antisymmetric A; free-fermion departure measured by aionq.majorana.gaussian_defect, which is exactly O(2n)-invariant

single_particle_branch.operation: reweight the spectrum of the Hermitian iA and map back
single_particle_branch.containment: structural: the result is real antisymmetric for ANY weight sequence, hence Gaussian
single_particle_branch.adversarial_check: weights of -3, 0, 1e3, and two random draws all leave so(2n) intact and the defect below 1e-8, so the containment is a property of the branch and not of the QFFO's particular weights

many_body_branch.operation: reweight the spectrum of H itself
many_body_branch.monotone_in_q: defects 1.019, then higher at q = 0.7, then 3.271 at q = 0.9

the_comparison_that_carries_the_content.reading: nearly the same distance travelled, fifteen orders of magnitude apart in whether the certificate survives. The difference is the DIRECTION of the excitation, not its size. That is what makes this a fiber/transverse split rather than a statement about magnitude.

correction_the_first_measurement_was_of_.what_happened: the generator was built as sum_{j<k} A_jk c_j c_k and then Hermitised. For j != k the Majorana product c_j c_k satisfies (c_j c_k)* = c_k c_j = -c_j c_k: it is ANTI-Hermitian. Symmetrising annihilated it exactly.
correction_the_first_measurement_was_of_.consequence: H = 0, exp(iH) = I, and BOTH branches reported free-fermion defect 0.000e+00. A clean dichotomy -- 'a spectral multiplier preserves the Gaussian class at either level' -- was one step from being recorded, from a measurement in which every operator was the identity.
correction_the_first_measurement_was_of_.what_caught_it: the zero was EXACT rather than 1e-16. Every other defect measured in this repository at machine precision reports 1e-15 or 1e-16; a literal 0.000e+00 across four independent configurations is not what a floating-point cancellation looks like.
correction_the_first_measurement_was_of_.the_fix: H = (i/4) sum A_jk c_j c_k. The factor of i is the entire difference and it is now carried by fishnet.quadratic_hamiltonian, with a test asserting that omitting it gives exactly zero.

supplies: a parameterised, invariantly-measured departure from the free-fermion class, generated by an operator carrying a fractal order rather than by a random kick. R1B and R1C recorded that the portfolio has no graded transverse direction: matchgate_plan certifies or refuses, and the only thing the frame group moves is routing.
the complementary control: a way to stir the network hard -- displacement 0.40 -- while remaining provably simulable, which is what an ablation needs and what a random perturbation cannot provide.
does_not_supply: a cost theorem. The departure is measured in the invariant defect, and nothing here bounds simulation cost by it. The R1B separation stands and this module is not imported by anything under src/aionq that feeds q_sim_upper.
a fractal set. R1E's conclusion is unchanged: a fractal ORDER is a parameter of a weight sequence, not a subset with a Hausdorff dimension, and docs/FALCONER_ASSESSMENT.md's gap is not narrowed.
a planarity or Euler-characteristic result. See the scope remainder.

typed_remainders.statement: The excitation was measured at n = 3, where so(2n) has dimension 15 inside an ambient 64. The interesting regime is large n, where the codimension grows exponentially, and the branches were not compared there. gaussian_defect costs O(n * 4^n) and is feasible to n = 5 or 6.

The 'Euler elegant contraction' half of the proposal is NOT addressed here and is recorded as open. matchgate_plan certifies nearest-neighbour adjacency in the qubit ordering, which is a ONE-DIMENSIONAL condition. The classical reason free-fermion counting is tractable -- Kasteleyn orientations and the FKT algorithm -- requires PLANARITY, which Euler's formula supplies and which is strictly weaker than 1D adjacency. So there are plausibly free-fermion circuits on planar but non-linear layouts that matchgate_plan refuses. That would be a false negative in a certified path, which is the safe direction for a bound and the wrong direction for a measurement, and it has not been demonstrated. Naming it is not measuring it.

The many-body branch reweights eigenvalues indexed in sorted order, so it depends on the eigensolver's ordering and, at a degenerate spectrum, on its arbitrary choice of eigenbasis. The spectrum measured here is non-degenerate. On a symmetric generator the branch would be ill-defined and the measurement would be of the eigensolver.
